The '''''Cardan III''-class space station''' was a medium defense platform used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to help secure areas of importance.

==History==
It was the middle-most of the [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class space stations]] both in name, and in relative power. While all variants of the ''Cardan'' space station saw use, the Mark III model was among the most commonly used throughout the Empire.<ref name="Mesop2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop2|text=Message to Spacers 2}}</ref>

To fulfill its role as a defense platform, the ''Cardan III'' possessed a number of [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]], [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries in addition to a quartet of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers. In addition, it carried a complement of four twelve-unit [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadrons&mdash;the same number of TIE/LN fighters carried by an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>&mdash;for patrol and space superiority. It also could quickly call upon [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruisers]] for reinforcements.

As with other ''Cardan''-class space stations, the Mark III could repair vessels or even build them from scratch.<ref name="Mesop2" /> With its integrated shipyard facilities, a ''Cardan III'' was capable of building and repairing vessels as large as a [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]].<ref name="EaW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref> While featuring considerably less firepower than a [[Golan space defense platform]] of comparable size, this ability to repair and construct vessels made it a valuable asset to [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleets]] far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]].
